snippet.title: Randomonium
snippet.description:
Former diamond level random Starcraft II player who has played League of Legends casually since Season 1 but only started playing ranked in Season 5.  My entire life I've been a coach and a mentor to hundreds of people in a wide range of sports, school subjects, and other activities.  This channel is dedicated to helping players improve and grow as players.  The strength of this channel is the league community.  I never make any of my videos in a vacuum.  I continually seek out advice from high ranked players and typically have over a dozen people provide inputs for each of my videos.  I'm a firm believer than educational content only gets better the more people you have involved so I'm always looking for feedback or people to collaborate with.  I'm also a firm believer in always citing my sources and giving credit where credit is due.  So don't be shy, leave a comment on a video or join our discord.

Discord: https://discord.gg/UQy7h4u
